sensitiveOrConsentFields: representative identities requested in the published instructions
optional local artist database and mail-out email consent

activityVerification.evidence: CKXU's official On-Air page links a January 2026 programming schedule, lists a populated seven-day lineup, and publishes station news dated June 18, June 19 and June 29, 2026. The official Contact page lists current staff and identifies Laura Ponce as Volunteer & Music Director.

genreFitEvidence: Current programming includes House of Crimson, The Encrypted Files, Factory Form, Eye of the Storm, Source, Afro Beats, Spinz808, Global Invasion and multiple indie, world, hip-hop and experimental programs.
Selected MarcsMusic electronic, house, techno, ambient, experimental, world-fusion, reggae/dancehall-adjacent or hip-hop-adjacent EP material has plausible fit.
The route rejects singles, so the catalogue must be reviewed for a coherent EP or LP before submission.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: The route is free and publicly authorized, but CKXU accepts EPs and LPs only, requires MP3 download delivery rather than streaming, requests content and identity-related information, and leaves international eligibility, technical limits, rights, release timing and AI-origin policy unresolved. Human review and manual submission are mandatory.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: Repository code search was checked for the station name, official domain and canonical submission path. No existing music-submission-agent record was found before creation.
deduplication.consolidation: The digital form, protected Music Department contacts and physical-mail alternative are stored as one canonical CKXU opportunity. The separate dated local music mail-out is excluded from the standard airplay route.

notes: One new CKXU opportunity was queued as needs_manual_review. No form field, download link, audio file, identity information, consent, email, login, CAPTCHA, payment or physical package was submitted.
